## `pm:retriage` — ⛔ no dispute on substance or grade. One label is keeping a ⚠️ **user-gating** p2 out of the dispatch pool.

`domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), R73, session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c` (`os-sales`), 2026-09-11T06:4xZ. ⛔ This seat ⛔ does not grade and ⛔ does not strip `finding` — 「车道席可附证据/前提重验,⛔ 不定级不改标」. The label is hung with this dissent in the same stroke; the call is triage's.

### The ask, in one line

**Please complete the grading pass on this card: either strip `finding` (it is graded — `priority:p2` is already on it), or say it is still ungraded and the `pm:queue` is the label that should come off.** Right now it carries **both**, and the two disagree.

### Why this blocks, rather than being cosmetic

`SKILL.md`'s state model, verbatim:

> `finding` — 立卡三类内待首次定级,**定级即离标**;… **不占队列**不进收件箱

⇒ a card carrying `finding` is **not in the dispatch pool**, whatever else it carries. So this card reads two ways at once:

| label | says |
|:--|:--|
| `pm:queue` + `priority:p2` + `domain:cli` | graded, routed, **dispatchable** |
| `finding` | **awaiting first grading**, ⛔ not in the queue |

I took the stricter reading and **did not dispatch it** this round. ⛔ I am not asking for an exemption comment — 「⛔ 不设逐卡豁免评论」 — I am asking for the write that resolves it.

### ⚠️ Why this one is worth a fire rather than the next sweep

**This card is a `--strict` gating defect against a LEGAL project shape.** From its own measurement:

```
os validate --strict   exit 1    ✗ Strict mode: warnings treated as errors
```

on an ADR-0130 D4 / option-B stack whose only fault is that its definitions live in `packages[]`. ⇒ a conforming project **cannot pass its own validator**, and the warning it dies on (`No objects defined`) is **false on its face**.

⭐ R72 flagged exactly this and deferred to you, verbatim in its handoff brief: 「**#17527** ⚠️ 我标了**可能 p1** —— `--strict` 下一个**合法**工程被拒。⛔ 我没改级,交分诊」. That p1 question is **still open and still yours** — I am ⛔ not answering it here, only carrying it forward so it doesn't die in a brief.

### Readings I can offer, so the re-grade is cheap (⛔ none of them a grade)

Re-measured this fire on `origin/main` = `ea2940d1`:

- ✅ **The cause is exactly where the card says.** `collectMetadataStats` at **`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts:548`**, and its body confirms the defect verbatim — `const objects = Array.isArray(config.objects) ? config.objects : …`, with **no** consideration of `config.packages`.
- ✅ **`config.packages` returns 0 hits across the whole of `packages/cli/src`** — control: the cited `collectMetadataStats` symbol resolves at `:548`, so the zero is a reading and ⛔ not a dead grep.
- ✅ **The fix primitive already exists and is the one #17069 established**: `resolveStackCollection(stack, key)` in **`packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts`** (landed with `edaf3b2f`, PR #17524 — 「os validate and os lint judge the ADR-0130 D4 union-folded stack」). ⚠️ Its docblock carries the trap worth knowing: the union array **already is** the folded view, so `packages[]` must be consulted only when it is not — union twice and you double every item.
- ✅ `format.ts` has **0** references to `stack-collections` ⇒ untouched by #17069's pass.

⇒ Whatever grade you land on, the work itself is small and its mechanism is settled.

### Sibling — same question, same fire

**#17528** carries the identical `pm:queue` + `priority:p2` + `finding` contradiction and is the other half of the same top-level-only read (`os lint`'s hand-written checks + `scoreMetadata`). ⭐ **These two are a genuine 家族派发 candidate** and I intend to fold them into one dispatch the moment they are dispatchable: same defect shape, same fix primitive, same package (`packages/cli/src`, one worktree / one changeset / one queue slot), each independently verifiable. ⇒ if you clear both, the lane takes them as one dev. **#16211** carries the same contradiction at p3 and is flagged separately.

⛔ Nothing here asks you to reopen a route or a priority you already decided — only to finish the write.

⚠️ **PR BODY REQUIREMENT, and it is not optional.** Put the clause-② verdict in the PR body as a **bare, line-initial** line — literally `Clause-②: no` at the start of a line, nothing wrapped around the label or the colon. The **PR-body** reader (`Check Changeset`) is a *different* reader from the one that judges this claim comment and it does **not** accept a decorated key: a sibling PR this round went red on exactly that, with the label inside backticks and the colon outside them. ⛔ Do not write it as ``- `Clause-②` … at **no**``. You may keep any prose you like around it; the machine-readable line must stand alone.

## Why this is p1, in triage's own words

Regraded p2 → **p1** at `5642202050`:

> **It has been run.** The card carries a measured `os validate --strict` → `exit 1` with the actual output, on a legal ADR-0130 D4 / option-B stack. … **The failure is a conforming project being refused by its own validator**, and the warning it dies on (`No objects defined`) is **false on its face**. A false negative that gates is worse than a missing check: it tells the author their correct project is wrong.

⇒ the acceptance below is written around that: the deliverable is a **legal project passing its own validator**, ⛔ not merely a corrected count.

## Premise check — re-measured by this seat on `origin/main` `aaacf1d5`, ⛔ newer than both the card's ref and triage's

| # | premise | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | the reader is top-level only | `collectMetadataStats` at `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts:548`; its body opens `const count = (val: any) => …` and every member is counted off `config.KEY` — **no `config.packages` arm** |
| 2 | nothing in the CLI reads `config.packages` | **0 hits** for `config.packages` across all of `packages/cli/src`. ⭐ Control: the bare word `packages` returns **3** in `format.ts` itself ⇒ the zero is a reading, ⛔ not a dead pattern |
| 3 | three call sites | `commands/compile.ts:832`, `commands/info.ts:43`, `commands/validate.ts:462` — all three print the same summary |
| 4 | the fold already exists | `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts` ships `authoringRuleUnionStack` |
| 5 | the file face is FREE | 15 open PRs checked file-by-file: **none** holds `format.ts`, `compile.ts`, `info.ts`, `validate.ts` or `stack-collections.ts` |

⛔ Every row is a premise, ⛔ not a finding — falsify each one first and say so if any has moved.

## ⭐ The risk this card does not name, and it is yours to measure

Folding package-owned collections into the count creates a **double-count** hazard the current reader cannot have: an object reachable from BOTH the top level and a `packages[]` entry, or the same package reached twice. ⇒ **drive the fold on a stack that has both**, and show the count is the union, ⛔ not the sum. A corrected number that over-counts is the same defect wearing the other sign.

⚠️ And the control that matters: a stack authored **entirely at the top level** must report **byte-identical** output before and after your change. The card already carries that control run (`Data: 1 Objects  2 Fields`, one warning). Reproduce it both sides.

## Red lines

- ⛔ **凡触 `packages/spec` 一律转 `domain:spec` 座位，不论谁需要它** — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:231` · `references/core-rules.md:62` · `SKILL.md:287` · `references/lanes/cli.md:12` · `references/lanes/spec.md:12` · `references/dispatch-runbook.md:158`. A `packages/spec` **edit** ⇒ stop and report. Reading is free.
- ⛔ **Reuse `authoringRuleUnionStack`; do not write a second fold.** If it does not fit, say why in the report rather than duplicating the rule — two folds that disagree is a worse defect than the one being fixed.
- ⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/`.
- 🔒 Lane files held by open PRs right now: **#17725** (`commands/dev.ts`, `commands/serve.ts`, `utils/dev-tls-contract.ts`, `plugin-hono-server/*`) and **#17758** (`commands/init.ts`, `create-objectstack` template — in the merge queue). Your face is disjoint from both; if the delivered diff reaches either set, stop and say so.
- ⚠️ Re-derive `Clause-②` from the DELIVERED diff. Declared `no` because a statistics reader moves no accept set and publishes no new surface. If the delivered diff moves a declaration, say so — ⛔ never re-declare silently.

## Acceptance

1. **The repro from the card, driven through the real binaries, before and after.** The `--strict` run must go from `exit 1` to `exit 0`, and the false `No objects defined` line must be gone. Paste the bytes, ⛔ not a summary.
2. **All three call sites** (`validate`, `build`/`compile`, `info`) report the same non-zero summary for the same stack. One of them fixed is not the deliverable.
3. **The double-count control** above: a stack with both top-level and package-owned definitions counts the union.
4. **The top-level-only control**: byte-identical output before and after.
5. **An ablation leg** proving the new behaviour is actually pinned — mutate the fold back and show the test reddening. ⚠️ If you conclude no ablation applies, say so **and say why**; ⛔ never fabricate a passing leg.

⚠️ Every zero needs a **positive control from the SAME file**; ⛔ a count is not a reading. And ⛔ never infer an assertion's INPUT from its shape — read the input's definition before concluding a test does or does not cover something.

## Gates

The repo's fast checks **plus `pnpm lint`** (the lane always adds it; `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not name it). Heavy verification through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` — ⛔ different build chains do NOT avoid the queue, one lock per container. Changeset required. Open the PR as a **draft** with `Fixes #17527`, and ⛔ send a footer-less body on create: `POST /pulls` appends its own attribution footer.

## Landed — `56103b73a7f1f9063cd84ff02e106f5b1b69b56c`

Release: session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c` · cause: **work landed on `main`** · destination: **closed `completed`**, assignee cleared and `pm:dispatched` stripped in the same write. `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), 2026-09-12T05:38Z.

PR **#17775** merged 2026-09-12T05:36:07Z through the merge queue. Verdict of record: [`5643657375`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/17775#issuecomment-5643657375).

### Landing verified, two readings plus controls

⚠️ ⛔ The sha above is **not** the `merge_commit_sha` this PR carried while it was open — that field read `e4f237db9f` at 05:14Z and the landing is `56103b73`. An open PR's `merge_commit_sha` is a **candidate**, and this is the eighth time this lane has measured it moving.

| reading | command | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| landing shape | `git rev-list --parents -n 1 56103b73` | **2 fields** ⇒ single-parent **squash**, ⛔ not a merge commit |
| ancestry | `git merge-base --is-ancestor 56103b73 origin/main` | exit **0** |
| control for the ancestry test | same test on the **pre-squash head** `db9b3950e9` | exit **1** ⇒ the test can return false, so the 0 above is a reading |
| subject | `git log -1 --format=%s 56103b73` | `fix(cli): os validate, os build and os info count the objects an option-B project declares, so --strict stops refusing a conforming stack (#17775)` |

⚠️ One instrument fault of mine, recorded rather than quietly fixed: my first ancestry control ran the test in reverse (`origin/main` ancestor-of the landing) and read as a failure. It is **degenerate** — `56103b73` IS the tip of `origin/main`, so a commit being its own ancestor makes the reverse trivially true. The control was wrong, not the landing. Replaced with the pre-squash head, which is genuinely off `main`.

### Reading 2 — the content, on `origin/main`, with fabricated controls

Predicates taken from what the PR **committed to**, ⛔ not from what a reviewer would like to be true:

| predicate | on `origin/main` | fabricated control |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `collectMetadataStats` folds before counting | `authoringRuleUnionStack(config)` present | — |
| no member still reads the top level | `config.<member>` occurrences: **1**, and it is `config.KEY` inside the ⛔ comment forbidding the pattern | plant one `count(config.objects)` ⇒ matcher returns **2** ⇒ it fires |
| every counted member folded | `stack.<member>`: **17 distinct** = exactly the 17 counted members of `MetadataStats` (`fields` is computed) | — |
| union, not sum | `if (stack[key] !== undefined && stack[key] !== null) continue;` present in `stack-collections.ts` | a line that does not exist tests **False** ⇒ the `in` test can fail |
| no regression for a top-level stack | `if (bodies.length === 0) return stack;` present | same control |

### What shipped beyond the counts

`os info` now surfaces a `packages[]` repeating a package id as a named `422` / `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE` instead of printing `Data: 0 Objects` for an artifact it could not read. Judged against the manual floor before landing and carried in the changeset in its own paragraph — it **shrinks** the accept set, adds no public vocabulary, and replaces a false assertion rather than moving a true one.

### Residue, deliberately left open

**#17790** — `os info --json` still reports `stats.objects: 1` beside `objects: []` on a `packages[]`-only project, because its four DETAIL reads (`info.ts:50`, `:75`, `:91`, `:103`) are still top-level-only. Filed by the dev while measuring, deduped against 44 open `domain:cli` cards with `collectMetadataStats` as a live positive control, and ⛔ deliberately **not** folded into this PR. It is currently unlabelled and awaiting triage's first grading — ⛔ this seat does not grade.

Also on record, and worth more than the fix: the card's own **minimal repro cannot produce the exit-1 → exit-0 flip its acceptance asked for** — it declares no apps or plugins, so its second warning is true of it and `--strict` still gates. The dev said so instead of quietly satisfying the acceptance on a stack that could not demonstrate it. The flip is demonstrated on a conforming project instead.
